name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 8 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 52 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-10-17, at wavelengths from 1.06 to 4.74 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
